meta.description: A self-report map of your inner system in IFS terms: Self, Managers, Firefighters and what they protect.

nav.footer: Transcendent Institute is a school of integrative psychology and self-leadership. This tool is a reflection aid — not therapy, not a quick fix, not a religion. It is not a validated psychometric instrument.

landing.title: Who is leading your inner life right now?
landing.lead: This short questionnaire maps how your inner system is organised at the moment, in the language of Internal Family Systems (IFS): how much Self-leadership is available, which group of parts tends to take the lead, and which parts are most active.
landing.ifs: In IFS the mind is a system of parts around a core Self. Managers protect proactively by organising daily life. Firefighters protect reactively when pain breaks through. Exiles are young parts carrying old burdens, kept out of sight. None of them is bad. Every one of them formed for a reason.
landing.notLabel: You will not get a label. IFS does not type people. You will get a map, and some questions worth bringing to the parts on it.
landing.time: About 10 minutes. 63 short statements. Nothing is stored unless you choose to at the end.
landing.disclaimer: This is a self-report reflection tool. It is not a validated psychometric instrument and does not assess or identify any condition. It is not therapy and not a substitute for professional support.
landing.program: Transcendent Institute teaches a Self Leadership Program that integrates IFS with Kabbalah, Yoga and Andean tradition. This tool belongs to its second level, Balance. You do not need the program to use the tool.

start.instruction: Answer for how you have actually been over the last 6 months, not how you would like to be. There are no right answers. Go with your first response. Some statements touch tender places. You can pause or stop at any time.

results.exerciseWhy: This short reflection is for the protector named above, the part that most often takes the lead in your answers. In IFS we begin with protectors, never with the young parts they guard: a protector that feels understood can relax, and only then does the system open. Nothing you write here leaves your device unless you choose to share it.

privacy.heading: Campaign source and partner links
privacy.attribution: If you arrive through a link that names a campaign or a partner (for example a link with ?utm_source= or ?ref= in it), we keep its campaign source, medium, campaign name and partner code in your browser for up to 30 days once you start the map, and store them with your results if you ask us to email them. We use them only to count which channels and partners bring people to the map. The copy stored with your results is deleted together with them, and it never contains your answers or your results.
privacy.analytics: We count visits to the public pages of the map (landing page, start, questions, results and privacy pages) and a few steps of the map (landing page viewed, map started, map completed, results emailed, program or live-session link clicked) with Vercel Web Analytics, which sets no cookies. A visit records the page address, keeping only the campaign and partner parameters of the link, plus the referring site and general information such as country, browser, operating system and device type. To tell visits apart within a day, Vercel derives an identifier from the request that is discarded after 24 hours. Each step records the language of the page and, if there is one, the partner code; a link click also records which link it was. None of it records your name, your email address, your answers or your results. Pages for program participants, facilitators and administrators are not counted.
